description: Server-side conversion events posted to api.quora.com/ads/v0/conversion. Browser pixels on q.quora.com stay directory-only.

params.name: account_id
params.description: It is the Quora Ads account id. Quora documents it as required on the Conversion API request.
params.fix_hint: Set `account_id` to the Ads account id from Quora Ads Manager.

params.name: conversion.event_name
params.description: It is the conversion event name. Quora documents a fixed PixelCategory set on the Conversion API.
params.fix_hint: Use a documented name such as `Purchase` or `Generic`.

params.name: conversion.click_id
params.description: It is the Quora click id (`qclid`). Quora documents it as the match key for ad attribution. Events without it are accepted but cannot be attributed to a click.
params.fix_hint: Send `conversion.click_id` as the `qclid` from the landing-page URL or `quora_qclid` cookie.

params.name: conversion.event_id
params.description: It identifies the event so Pixel and CAPI can deduplicate. Quora documents sharing the same `event_id` across both.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable `conversion.event_id` on both the pixel and the Conversion API call.

params.name: conversion.value
params.description: It is the conversion value. Quora's Conversion API tag sends it as a number.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `129.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: conversion.timestamp
params.description: It is the event time. Quora's Conversion API tag sends microseconds since epoch.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer timestamp. The official tag uses microseconds.

params.name: device.user_agent
params.description: It is the device user agent. Quora's Conversion API tag sends it unhashed when the client provides it.
params.fix_hint: Send `device.user_agent`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: device.referer
params.description: It is the page referrer. Quora's Conversion API tag uses the `referer` spelling.
params.fix_hint: Send `device.referer`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: device.language
params.description: It is the device language. Quora's Conversion API tag sends it when the client provides it.
params.fix_hint: Send `device.language`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: device.mobile_device_id
params.description: It is the mobile advertising id. Quora's Conversion API tag sends it when the client provides it.
params.fix_hint: Send `device.mobile_device_id`, or drop the empty pair.
